children: Prices of Brent crude oil above $105 per barrel are becoming a broader headwind for assets including equities and precious metals, OCBC Group Research's Christopher Wong says in a research report. Currencies of Asia ex-Japan countries, especially net energy importers like India's rupee, and "high beta" currencies like the Australian dollar and the Korean won have come under some pressure, the FX strategist says.The U.S. dollar edges 0.2% lower to 1,347.30 won, while the Australian dollar is 0.1% higher at US$0.7159, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
